title: SchedulerPerformance
description: An entry in the kubemoot_scheduler_performance bucket: one agent's recent model requests and capacity waits for one model on one provider, which the scheduler learns from. Key: <provider>.<model>.<agent>, each token escaped. Times are milliseconds; an engine timing the engine did not report is -1.

agent.description: The agent that wrote the entry, as <namespace>/<agent>.

updatedAt.description: When the entry was last written, epoch milliseconds.

requests.description: Requests this agent has recorded for the model on the provider.

failures.description: How many of those requests failed or timed out.

samples.description: The most recent requests, oldest first.

at.description: When the request started, epoch milliseconds.

kind.description: tool-turn: one model turn of the tool loop. simple: a no-tool call (advisory, synthesis). triage: a triage call. calibration: a probe the scheduler sent to measure the provider, not a crew call.

ok.description: False when the request failed or timed out.

coldStart.description: The model was not resident on the provider when the call was placed.

promptTokens.description: Prompt tokens the engine reported; 0 when unknown.

outputTokens.description: Generated tokens the engine reported; 0 when unknown.

durationMs.description: Time from sending the request to the reply or failure, measured by the agent.

loadMs.description: Model load time the engine reported; -1 when not reported.

promptEvalMs.description: Prompt processing time the engine reported; -1 when not reported.

evalMs.description: Generation time the engine reported; -1 when not reported.

activeCalls.description: Calls holding a ticket on the provider when the request started, this one included.

waits.description: The most recent waits for capacity that ended with a call placed here, oldest first.

at.description: When the wait started, epoch milliseconds.
